name: Cable Biceps Curl
summary: A standing isolation exercise that uses a low cable pulley to maintain constant tension on the elbow flexors throughout the curl.

setup: Attach a straight bar or EZ-curl bar to the lowest setting of a cable pulley.
Grasp the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Step back slightly to create tension on the cable, standing upright with feet hip-width apart and elbows pinned near your sides.
steps: Keep your upper arms stationary and curl the bar upward toward your chest by flexing your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps firmly at the top of the contraction.
Lower the bar under control until your elbows are fully extended, resisting the pull of the cable throughout the descent.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you curl the bar upward and inhale as you lower it back to the starting position.
cues: Glue your elbows to your ribs
Keep your torso still and resist leaning back
Control the descent all the way down

common_faults.fault: Swinging the torso backward to initiate the curl with momentum.
common_faults.correction: Brace your core, reduce the weight, and keep your spine vertical throughout the movement.

common_faults.fault: Allowing the elbows to drift excessively forward during the lift.
common_faults.correction: Keep your upper arms pinned to your sides to ensure the tension stays on the biceps rather than shifting to the front deltoids.

precautions: Maintain a neutral wrist position to prevent excess strain on the forearm tendons.
